title: CodecFlow: Efficient Bandwidth Extension via Conditional Flow Matching in Neural Codec Latent Space
abstract: arXiv:2603.02022v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Speech Bandwidth Extension improves clarity and intelligibility by restoring/inferring appropriate high-frequency content for low-bandwidth speech. Existing methods often rely on spectrogram or waveform modeling, which can incur higher computational cost and have limited high-frequency fidelity. Neural audio codecs offer compact latent representations that better preserve acoustic detail, yet accurately recovering high-resolution latent information remains challenging due to representation mismatch. We present CodecFlow, a neural codec-based BWE framework that performs efficient speech reconstruction in a compact latent space. CodecFlow employs a voicing-aware conditional flow converter on continuous codec embeddings and a structure-constrained residual vector quantizer to improve latent alignment stability. translated_title: CodecFlow：基于神经编解码器潜空间中条件流匹配的高效带宽扩展
translated_abstract: 语音带宽扩展通过为低带宽语音恢复或推断合适的高频内容来提升语音的清晰度和可懂度。现有方法通常依赖频谱图或波形建模，这会带来较高的计算成本，且高频保真度有限。神经音频编解码器提供了紧凑的潜空间表示，能够更好地保留声学细节，但由于表示不匹配的问题，如何准确恢复高分辨率的潜空间信息仍然是一个挑战。我们提出了CodecFlow，一个基于神经编解码器的带宽扩展框架，能够在紧凑的潜空间中实现高效的语音重建。CodecFlow在连续的编解码器嵌入上采用了声调感知的条件流转换器，并结合结构约束的残差向量量化器来提升潜空间对齐的稳定性。通过端到端优化，CodecFlow在8 kHz到16 kHz（摘要在此处截断）的任务上实现了出色的频谱保真度和增强的感知质量。
tldr: CodecFlow提出了一种基于神经编解码器潜空间的语音带宽扩展框架，通过声调感知条件流转换器和结构约束残差向量量化器实现高效重建，在8kHz至16kHz扩展任务中达到优异的频谱保真度和感知质量。
en_tdlr: CodecFlow is a neural codec-based speech bandwidth extension framework that employs a voicing-aware conditional flow converter and a structure-constrained residual vector quantizer to achieve efficient speech reconstruction with strong spectral fidelity in a compact latent space.
